scope: Independent collector-to-replay audit of main commit 03b391c96162d3ec1dce39442125d90cd9a96e51. Synthetic HTTP responses exercise the actual sources.Client; no synthetic match or price is a published pick.

production_observation.observed_via: GitHub Actions jobs and check-run annotations API
production_observation.result: failed at Reconcile every row, replay every probability and build linked pages; deployment was skipped
production_observation.limitation: The full log download redirects to a host outside the sandbox allowlist. The three defects below were independently reproduced locally, not asserted to be the inaccessible run's exact traceback.

findings.finding: TWC line replay compares the SHA-256 of re-serialized saved JSON to the raw HTTP response digest. Compact provider JSON and Client.save's indented representation differ, so normal evidence is rejected.
findings.observed_exception: ValueError: TWC line evidence hash mismatch

findings.finding: _collect_kalshi returns ((provider, pages), pages); collect appends the first tuple instead of a provider object. JSON turns it into a list. Replay expects a dict. The no-Polymarket success path also breaks the caller's provider.get('quote') test.
collect stores fixture.teams as objects with a name field, but replay wraps each object again in {'name': n}. The replayed team names are dictionaries instead of strings.

limitations: Active T/A3/W implementations were not edited by this audit.
A previous successful deployment does not establish that the newly merged code is published.
The public site was serving the dated checked-in fallback on the observation, not a verified 17 October inventory. No old timestamp was replaced with today's date.

additional_observation_regressions.result: one positive-control test passes; stale/future rejection and oldest-source consensus tests fail (three failing subcases)
findings: Kalshi accepts a source observation nine hours old and one hour in the future; no is_fresh guard is applied to its nested event quote.
The combined TWC line takes max(provider observation) rather than min; a newer provider can incorrectly extend the lifetime of an older contributing quote.
